mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: A product labelled pure in common usage may still be a mixture in science.

mx.teacher_note: Judge from the most visible feature in the figure, not from the mechanism's test.

intelligence.enrichment: In science, a pure substance has no other substance present in it, consists of the same type of particles, and cannot be separated into other kinds of matter by a physical process. If more than one substance is present, the material is scientifically impure even when it may be unadulterated in everyday language. The learner correctly applies this rule: In science, a pure substance has no other substance present in it, consists of the same type of particles, and cannot be separated into other kinds of matter by a physical process. Pure on a product label means the material is a pure substance in science.
